title: Nexus CoreRunEventsResponse
description: Bounded run-events page with explicit terminal and resync inspection; consumers treat resync_required as a gap and explicitly resynchronize.

payload.description: Event payload; extensible JSON, absent when the kind carries none.

next_sequence.description: Decimal string sequence watermark after this page.

terminal.description: True when the run has reached a terminal state and no further events can be produced.

resync_required.description: True when the requested tail has been retention-trimmed; the caller must resynchronize.
